en.short_description: Community traffic reports, nearby hazard alerts, and live public safety radio.
en.description:
iMaps is a dark-themed, community-powered navigation app. It combines worldwide turn-by-turn driving routes with incident reports from other drivers, a live feed of official hazard alerts within two miles of you, and streaming public safety radio — in one app, in fifteen languages.

—— Navigation ——

Worldwide driving routes and step-by-step guidance, powered by OSRM (Open Source Routing Machine). Enter a destination and follow a clear, high-contrast route built for night driving.

—— Community incident reports ——

Report what you see — accidents, police, road hazards, heavy traffic — and confirm reports from other drivers. Reports lose severity automatically over time, so a stale report quietly fades instead of misleading the next driver.

—— A two-mile alert radius ——

iMaps aggregates five public data sources and shows only what is genuinely near you:

• USGS — local earthquakes, magnitude 1.0 and above, past 24 hours
• NOAA / National Weather Service — active severe weather alerts
• NASA FIRMS — active wildfire hotspots
• GDACS — global disaster alerts for cyclones, floods and volcanoes
• Open311 — municipal reports such as potholes and signal outages

—— Public safety radio ——

Stream live police, fire, EMS, NOAA Weather Radio and air traffic control feeds via OpenMHz and LiveATC. Useful during a storm, a closure, or a commute you want to understand.

—— Fifteen languages ——

Fully localized in English, Spanish, Mandarin, Hindi, French, Arabic, German, Japanese, Portuguese, Korean, Italian, Russian, Turkish, Indonesian and Swahili.

—— Companion browser extension ——

An optional Chrome, Edge and Firefox extension mirrors live events and radio streams in your browser.

—— About your location ——

iMaps needs your location to route you and to decide which alerts are within two miles. Your position is used to query public feeds and is not sold, and no advertising identifier is read. Full detail is in the privacy policy linked from this listing.

Drive attentively. Please do not interact with the app while your vehicle is moving.

en.release_notes:
First public release of iMaps.

• Worldwide turn-by-turn driving routes powered by OSRM
• Community incident reporting with automatic severity decay
• Two-mile live alert radius from USGS, NOAA/NWS, NASA FIRMS, GDACS and Open311
• Live public safety radio: police, fire, EMS, NOAA Weather Radio and ATC
• Fifteen languages
• Companion browser extension for Chrome, Edge and Firefox

Feedback is welcome at contact@safecodeg.com.

review_information.notes:
2. DEVICES AND OS VERSIONS TESTED
Automated tests run on every build: iPhone 17 Pro Max and iPad Pro 13-inch simulators on iOS 26, and a Pixel Android emulator on API 34.
Each release is also installed and launched on those targets, so a
build that cannot start never ships.

3. WHAT THIS APP DOES, AND FOR WHOM
iMaps is a dark-themed, community-powered navigation app. It combines worldwide turn-by-turn driving routes with incident reports from other drivers, a live feed of official hazard alerts within two miles of you, and streaming public safety radio — in one app, in fifteen languages.

Intended audience:
Traffic, alerts & live radio

4. SETTING UP AND REACHING THE MAIN FEATURES
The app opens on a sign-in screen. An account is optional; the main features can be reached without signing in.

5. EXTERNAL SERVICES USED
- Supabase — account and data storage
- Google AdMob — advertising
- Google Sign-In — authentication
- Sign in with Apple — authentication
- Apple In-App Purchase — paid features
- device location services (on-device)
- HTTPS requests to the app's own endpoints

6. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
The app ships 15 languages (Arabic, Chinese (Simplified), English, French, German, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, id, sw, tr). Features are identical in every region.

7. REGULATED INDUSTRY OR THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL

The app is not in a regulated industry and carries no licensed third-party material. All content, artwork and copy are the developer's own.


ACCOUNT DELETION
Account deletion is available in the app under Settings, and on the support site.
